hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r)\b" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]+\s+\S*(node_modules|__pycache__|\.cache|\.pytest_cache|\.ruff_cache)"; then echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf is destructive. Use targeted removal." >&2; exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+push\s+.*--force"; then echo "BLOCKED: force push. Rebase and push normally, or ask the user." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "systemctl\s+(stop|disable)\s+(--\S+\s+)*whisper"; then echo "BLOCKED: stopping/disabling whisper.service takes prod STT down. Use restart, or ask the user first." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; echo "$CMD" | grep -q "config.json" || exit 0; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "scp\s+\S*config\.json|(ssh|orange).*(>\s*config\.json|sed\s+-i.*config\.json|tee\s+.*config\.json|rm\s+.*config\.json)"; then echo "BLOCKED: the server config.json legitimately differs from the local one (see /deploy). Never overwrite it as part of a deploy." >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "scp\s+\S*app/"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Deploy is git pull on the server, not scp (see /deploy skill). Copying app/ files by hand desyncs the server from git.\"}"; fi'

bash -c 'F="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; R=""; case "$F" in */app/audio/*) R="audio.md";; */app/core/*) R="transcribers.md";; */app/routes.py|*/app/infrastructure/validation.py) R="api.md";; esac; [ -z "$R" ] && exit 0; K=$(echo "$R" | tr -d " ."); M="/tmp/.whisper-rules-$K-${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-$(date +%j)}"; [ -f "$M" ] && exit 0; touch "$M"; echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Path-scoped rules apply — READ .claude/rules-scoped/$R (reminder fires once per session).\"}"'
bash -c 'F="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$F" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ruff format "$F" >/dev/null 2>&1'
bash -c 'echo "=== Git ==="; git status --short; echo; git log --oneline -5'

bash -c 'git fetch origin 2>/dev/null; BEHIND=$(git log HEAD..origin/dev --oneline 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BEHIND" ]; then echo; echo "=== WARNING: dev is behind origin ==="; echo "$BEHIND"; echo "Run: git rebase origin/dev"; fi'
bash -c 'echo; echo "=== whisper.service (orange) ==="; curl -s --max-time 5 http://stt.ai.gray/health || echo "health check unreachable"; echo'
